name: monnc
description: A cinematic streaming discovery front-end (Astro + Svelte + Video.js) with a Python backend proxying TMDB and serving playable streams.

TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: TMDB v4 Read Access Token (preferred) or v3 API key. Stays server-side.

PUBLIC_API_BASE.description: Deployed origin the frontend calls for /api (e.g. https://monnc.herokuapp.com). Inlined at build time.

PROXY_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_TARGETS.description: false (default) restricts /px to known 111movies bcdn hosts; true = general gateway (SSRF risk).
